Name: Lolita Fashion Bachelorettes
Author: Royalyspooky
Description:
I just thought one day "Why not have the bachelorettes of Stardew Valley wear Lolita Fashion?" so I set to work on it. All bachelorettes have been completed but I intend to make some alternatives.

I wanted to give thanks to  Chrysanthe for making the No more Bowlegs mod which is making the process easier.
